description: Sazgar Engineering Works Limited was established in 1991 and, in its own words, became a household name for 3-wheeler vehicles and automotive wheel rims for the tractor industry. It is a public limited company listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, manufactures at 18-KM Raiwind Road, Lahore, and says its three-wheelers are exported to more than 20 countries. Its product range covers petrol and CNG three-wheelers, the electric eVe rickshaw, tractor wheel rims, and HAVAL and BAIC passenger vehicles listed in its products menu.
headOffice: 88-Ali Town, Thokar Niaz Baig, Raiwind Road, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: https://sazgarautos.com/home (history, products, exports, registered office and telephone), https://sazgarautos.com/corporate-information/ (status and registration), https://sazgarautos.com/board-of-directors/ (CEO), https://sazgarautos.com/products/, https://sazgarautos.com/eve/ and https://sazgarautos.com/tractor-wheel-rims/ (product ranges) (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: Deluxe Mini Cab three-wheelers
products.summary: 200cc water-cooled four-stroke CNG/petrol rickshaws with disc brakes, offered in Deluxe, Royal Deluxe and Deluxe XL variants.

products.name: Seven- and nine-seater three-wheelers
products.summary: Seven-seater models carrying six passengers plus driver, and nine-seaters, used for fixed routes and shuttle services as well as by families.

products.name: Cargo loaders
products.summary: Shandar 150, Jaandar 200 and Cargo 100 loaders, in standard and front-hood versions, for goods carrying.

products.name: eVe electric rickshaw
products.summary: A battery-electric three-wheeler offered with 72V batteries from 90Ah to 160Ah, 2-3 kW motors and an approximate range of 100 to 210 km.

products.name: Tractor wheel rims
products.summary: Wheel rims for Fiat and Massey Ferguson tractors, made with CNC flash butt welders, rim rolling machines and presses up to 600 tons.

products.name: HAVAL passenger vehicles
products.summary: The company's products menu lists HAVAL Pakistan passenger vehicles, and the HAVAL site is published as 'GWM Sazgar'; BAIC vehicles are listed alongside it.
